scope: Same as current xCP figure: original seven, first versus exactly second possession, starts at least 60 yards from goal; all physical throws including centering
method: Two-sided percentile whole-game bootstrap; both teams and stages receive the same game weight; no p-values computed.
multiplicity: League: five-measure Bonferroni check. Teams: 22-team check within each measure, plus a stricter exploratory 110-comparison check across all five measures and 22 teams. Does not cover every earlier analysis or filter in the project.

definitions.cpoe: 100 × mean(max(complete, drop) − cp); drops credited as completed under confirmed production policy
definitions.huck_completion: 100 × actual completed hucks / huck attempts; drops are unsuccessful catches

limitations: Exploratory; variables come from existing literature-based plan but this joint testing family was selected after earlier results.
No causal inference, centering removal, or exact starting-position matching.
Huck completion and huck-share intervals are suppressed when a stage has identical binary outcomes; ordinary resampling cannot estimate that uncertainty.
No event-level aEC or LC comparison was attempted; no unavailable metrics invented.
